title: Neural Visual Decoding via Cognitive guided Adaptive Blurring and Information Constrained Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2605.16418v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: EEG-based visual decoding aims to establish a mapping between neural signals and visual semantics. However, it remains constrained by the dual challenges of severe information granularity mismatch and the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of EEG signals. Existing approaches typically treat visual features as static, ignoring the dynamic selectivity of human vision and the frequency specificity of neural oscillations. To bridge this gap, we propose CAIA, a Cognitive-guided Adaptive blurring with Information-Constrained Alignment framework for Neural-Visual decoding. On the visual side, it simulates selective attention to adaptively reduce redundancy. Meanwhile, on the EEG side, it combines neural oscillation priors with an information-bottleneck-inspired spectral sparsity regularizer to enhance SNR. Specifically, we devise a cognitive-dynamics-based adaptive blurring mechanism that dynamically integrates center-biased and saliency

translated_title: 基于认知引导的自适应模糊与信息约束对齐的神经视觉解码
translated_abstract: 基于EEG的视觉解码旨在建立神经信号与视觉语义之间的映射。然而，该任务仍然受到信息粒度严重不匹配以及EEG信号低信噪比（SNR）这一双重挑战的制约。现有方法通常将视觉特征视为静态的，忽略了人类视觉的动态选择性和神经振荡的频率特异性。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了CAIA——一个用于神经-视觉解码的认知引导自适应模糊与信息约束对齐框架。在视觉方面，该框架通过模拟选择性注意来自适应地减少冗余；同时，在EEG方面，它将神经振荡先验与受信息瓶颈启发的频谱稀疏正则化器相结合以提升信噪比。具体而言，我们设计了一种基于认知动力学的自适应模糊机制，该机制能够动态地整合中心偏置和显著性……
tldr: 该论文提出CAIA框架，通过基于认知动力学的自适应模糊机制模拟人类视觉的选择性注意以减少视觉特征冗余，并融合神经振荡先验与信息瓶颈启发的频谱稀疏正则化来提升EEG信噪比，从而解决脑电视觉解码中信息粒度不匹配与低信噪比的双重挑战。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CAIA, a framework that employs a cognitive-dynamics-based adaptive blurring mechanism to simulate selective attention for reducing visual redundancy, and combines neural oscillation priors with an information-bottleneck-inspired spectral sparsity regularizer to enhance EEG signal-to-noise ratio, addressing the dual challenges of information granularity mismatch and low SNR in EEG-based visual decoding.
